note: Commands scored by a bug-finding benchmark. Any of these left in the training
set makes that benchmark unmeasurable for a fine-tuned model: the model was
trained on the very gold answer the benchmark checks, and the check is often
'did the model leave this output unconstrained' -- which is exactly what the
gold does. Pass this file to build_dataset.py --hold-out-file to force them
all into the held-out set at every version.
This file is a list, not a claim that these commands are buggy. It is the
union of every command either benchmark scores, including the items labelled
false positives, because a scored FP item is as contaminated as a scored TP.
